summary: Liberty Broadband filed an 8-K reporting entry into a loan agreement with Charter Communications, the acquirer under a previously announced merger agreement (Nov 12, 2024). Charter advanced a ~$359 million term loan to Liberty Broadband on May 12, 2026. The loan bears interest at Term SOFR plus 2.00%, matures six months after the merger's drop-dead date or termination, and is secured by certain subsidiary equity. This reflects financing to support the pending merger. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder votes; the risk-arb spread will hinge on closing timeline and any antitrust conditions.
